note: watch-flow-polish 4.1 golden joint: ONE fixture pins BOTH halves of the chapters-to-chip contract. Each vector carries a verbatim ffprobe chapters blob (the projector's production input — cmd/mellifera decodes the stored document with plain json.Unmarshal, so numbers are float64), the sections internal/stream/describe.go projectChapters MUST emit (the served descriptor shape), and the expected skip classification per section — intro | credits | null — that web/src/lib/skipSections.ts must reproduce. Go half: TestSectionsGolden (internal/stream/sections_golden_test.go). SPA half: sections_projection_golden (web/src/lib/skipSections.test.ts). A change on either side alone fails that side's suite.

vectors.name: served_lexicons_classify_both_languages
vectors.note: the full intro/credits lexicon on real ffprobe chapter shapes (titles nested under tags.title, boundaries from the primary *_time strings): every lexicon word — intro: intro/opening/опенинг; credits: credits/ending/ed/титры — classifies, Cyrillic included

vectors.name: unclassifiable_titles_project_but_classify_to_nothing
vectors.note: story chapters — Russian and English, muxer-styled — project with their titles carried through and classify to nothing: the lexicon never stretches

vectors.name: end_less_and_degenerate_chapters_carry_no_end
vectors.note: an end-less chapter (no end/end_time facts) and a degenerate zero-width chapter (end == start) both project WITHOUT an end key — the classifier requires a real range, so neither may fabricate a chip

vectors.name: untitled_chapter_classifies_to_nothing
vectors.note: a chapter whose tags carry no title projects untitled — the descriptor omits the key, the classifier answers nothing

vectors.name: unordered_input_projects_sorted_by_start
vectors.note: the descriptor's served order is start-ascending no matter the blob's order — the same order skipSections must preserve when it compacts the classified ranges

vectors.name: unusable_chapter_is_dropped
vectors.note: a chapter without a usable start (unparseable *_time, no numeric raw) never reaches the descriptor — a section the SPA cannot seek to must not be served at all

vectors.name: raw_time_base_boundaries_convert
vectors.note: the raw fallback: chapters without *_time strings convert their integer boundaries through time_base (1/1000 and 1/90000) — the converted seconds classify like any other

web_defensive.note: The projection never produces these kinds (marker is reserved, v1) — this block pins the classifier's kind-guard on served-typed shapes; the Go golden does not run projectChapters over it.
